description: Cases for the stdio details panel under a short process-wide UiValue arena: a csv-shaped document, the headroom left free while it renders (a share of what its complete render measurably holds), and whether the details window renders whole or shortened (never refused).

headroom.description: Arena collections left free while the details window renders, relative to the collections its complete render holds (none, a third, half, or all of them plus one priced row).
